title: PNP steps up drive vs illegal recruiters after ‘rescue’ of 3 Filipinos
summary: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police is intensifying its crackdown on suspected illegal recruiters after three Filipinos who had been promised military jobs supposedly paying P200,000…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police is intensifying its crackdown on suspected illegal recruiters after three Filipinos who had been promised military jobs supposedly paying P200,000 a month in Eastern Europe were apprehended at Davao International Airport. “Illegal recruiters prey on the hopes of our kababayans (compatriots) by disguising dangerous schemes as opportunities for
